items.statement: India capacity utilisation in high 80s for both car and truck tyres; will hit constraints by end FY27
items.quote: Our current capacity utili sation level in India are in the high 80s, and given our growth expectations for the near future, as seen by the current demand momentum, we would start hitting capacity limitations soon

items.statement: India Q3 volume growth mid-teens YoY across all channels; OEM and replacement mid-teens, exports just under 20%
items.quote: Our volume growth for OEM and replacement was in mid-teens and in exports it was just short of 20%. So we've had a healthy growth, as I mentioned, across all the three channels.

items.statement: Europe demand remains weak; PCR market -4% in Q3, still in low single-digit negative
items.quote: Right now, Europe continues to be a weak market. Even in Q3, the quarter gone by, the passenger car Europe market, which is the most relevant category, the market growth was -1%. It sort of improved from a mid to high single digit negative to this level. But it continues to be in the low single digit. I'm in fact, sorry, the Europe market was -4%.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin 15.3% in Q3 vs 14.9% Q2 and 13.7% YoY; India 14.5% vs 15.3% Q2, Europe 17.9% vs 12.7% Q2
items.quote: The consolidated EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 11.9 billion, an improved margin of 15.3% compared to 14.9% in the last quarter and 13.7% in the same quarter last year.

items.statement: India margin impacted by BCCI sponsorship spend timing; Europe margin up 520bps QoQ to 17.9%
items.quote: The profitability was impacted, as we have discussed over various calls and meetings, by the timing of the spend on the BCCI sponsorship, which started in this quarter relative to our other A&P spends, and is only a near-term impact.

items.statement: Pricing stable in replacement market; no pricing action taken; raw material tailwind supported margins
items.quote: Pricing has largely remained stable, Arvind. It's held up. We haven't taken any pricing action. People have been competitive, but the raw material tailwind has played into the margins as you would see for all the players.

items.statement: Key raw material prices: natural rubber INR 195/kg, synthetic rubber INR 170/kg, carbon black INR 115/kg, steel cord INR 155/kg
items.quote: The prices for some of the commodities - natural rubber was around INR 195 a kg, synthetic rubber at INR 170, carbon black at INR 115 and steel cord at around INR 155 rupees a kg.

items.statement: If raw material stable, would need mid-single digit price increases annually to maintain returns on new capex
items.quote: We would probably need to take a mid-single digit kind of price increase every year.

items.statement: Europe UHP mix increased to 52% in Q3 from 48% YoY
items.quote: Continuing with our premiumi sation journey, the UHP mix for the quarter increased to 52%, compared to the 48% for the same quarter last year

items.statement: BCCI sponsorship driving strong traction in PCR, two-wheeler and farm categories, especially rural
items.quote: Given what we have been able to do with BCCI, we are seeing a lot of traction coming from the rural market, specifically in three categories which is PCR, two-wheeler and farm category. And that's where the growth is coming.

items.statement: Net debt fell to INR 13bn from INR 26bn QoQ due to working capital borrowings reduction from inventory drawdown
items.quote: The sharp decrease in net debt was driven by reduction in short-term borrowings as a result of strong operational cash flows.

items.statement: Consolidated net debt INR 13bn (0.4x EBITDA); India net debt INR 18bn (0.7x EBITDA); interest benefit to reflect next quarter
items.quote: The net debt to EBITDA for the consolidated operations dropped to 0.4x at the end of De cember 2025 compared to 0.8x at the end of September 2025

items.statement: One-time charge INR 259mn for estimated obligation under new labour code based on actuarial valuation
items.quote: In our standalone results for this quarter, the exceptional item below the EBITDA includes a one-time charge of INR 259 million on account of the estimated obli gation under the new labour code

items.statement: TBR replacement market share ~30%; PCR replacement market share ~20% (no official data)
items.quote: We would put our TBR replacement share close to 30% and our PCR replacement close to 20%.

items.statement: Current ROCE 13.5% vs 15% target; new 5-year vision from April 2026 under preparation
items.quote: So our current year ROCE we are running at 13.5%. It is in the band where we had set out our targets, but still not reaching that 15% target where we wanted to be.

items.statement: Europe demand still negative across PCR, agri, truck; long-term trend 1-2% growth; no further capacity expansion planned unless demand changes
items.quote: The Netherlands demand for last one year has been in the negative zone. It's improved from where it was, from significant negative to slight negative across product categories. But it is still negative. PCR, agri, truck, all of them. Long-term trend of the European market is generally a 1% to 2% growth.

items.statement: Q3 PBDIT margin fell to 5.8% from 7.3% YoY; 9M margin 6.3% vs 6.9% YoY
items.quote: PBDIT for the period INR80.9 crores and its percentage to revenue was 5.8% as compared to last year's INR89.6 crores which was 7.3% on revenue.

items.statement: YTD material cost innovation benefit INR35 cr offset by INR29 cr forex and INR18 cr commodity headwinds
items.quote: The cost innovation, what has come in P&L on a YTD basis was INR35 crores. But what has happened is during the same period, forex has depreciated by around 6%. The impact of that on material cost was INR29 crores negative. Also the commodity, mainly copper and GP has increased. So this negative impact was another INR18 crores.

items.statement: Full-year material cost reduction target INR79 cr (Q1 INR4 cr, Q2 INR12 cr, Q3 INR19 cr, Q4 expected INR44 cr)
items.quote: As far as the material cost project with A&M is concerned, -- so in the first quarter, we had cost INR4 crores; second quarter, INR12 crores; third quarter INR19 crores -- we are expecting INR44 crores. So we are expecting to close the year with a material cost reduction of INR79 crores.

items.statement: Import content 20-30% of COGS for Home Appliances (80% of company revenue); company-level import content similar
items.quote: Product to product, it differs. It is between 20% to 30%.

items.statement: Price hikes planned for Q4 to pass on cost increases; pass-through is a judicial call based on market scenario
items.quote: We have planned that. This will be a judicial call based on the market scenario. And we have already planned something for the Q4.

items.statement: Top-loader growth far ahead of industry; front-loader share maintained with slight improvement; AC share ~3-3.5% in split AC market
items.quote: In top loaders, the growth rate is far ahead of the industry growth rate and is far ahead of any player in the industry. That is for the top loader, I have answered. In terms of front loaders, I said that we have been able to maintain the market share. It has not increased substantially, but we have been able to retain our position.

items.statement: Front-load capacity 85-90k at 88% utilisation; top-load 65k at ~90% peak; AC 80-85% peak utilisation; capacity expansion work started
items.quote: As far as capacity for front loader is concerned, we have got capacity about 85,000 to 90,000, and we have used about 88%. So still we have got enough capacity to meet the market needs. Similarly, in top loader, we have got a capacity of about 65,000. There also, we are operating at around 90% in the peak months.

items.statement: Engineering division FY26 capex ~INR100 cr (Bangalore); additional INR200 cr planned for Gujarat EV/auto project (Phase 1), INR50-75 cr for Gurgaon; total potential INR300-400 cr with land
items.quote: This year, Engineering division is nearly doing INR100 crores of capex. We are modernizing our lines. We are adding new presses. There are new businesses from newer customers, which have called for.

items.statement: Gujarat project Phase 1 INR200 cr targeting INR200 cr sales initially, up to INR400-500 cr by year 3; Gurgaon project ~INR50-75 cr for INR100 cr+ sales; Bangalore chain factory INR150-200 cr initially up to INR500 cr
items.quote: Phase 1 will be INR200 crores, INR200 crores going up to INR400 crores, INR500 crores in the third year.

items.statement: Engineering division targeting >20% annual growth; order pipeline maturing; new revenue streams from Gujarat EV project, brake discs, increased share with OEMs
items.quote: Our growth targets are in excess of 20% per annum. We intend to grow and we are pushing the order obtainment in that direction only.

items.statement: Engineering division PBDIT margin currently 14.5% (lower due to electronics start-up costs); target 17-18%
items.quote: regarding margins, we are currently at 14.5% PBDIT, which is sligh tly lower than previous quarters. This is because some start-up expenses we are doing in the electronics sector. We hope to recover that. And Engineering division margin objective is 17% to 18

items.statement: New CEO joining by 15 April from >INR20,000 cr sales company with 20+ years double-digit margin track record; not from consumer durables but strong sales/distribution/marketing background
items.quote: We found our CEO. The CEO has agreed to join by 15th of April. CEO is not from a consumer durable company. Neither is the CEO from a different industry, but very well experienced in sales and distribution and marketing. He comes with that background and comes from a company of over INR20,000 crores sales. The company is very well known and well known for consistent double-digit margin for over 20

items.statement: McKinsey-led project to tie up 3,000 key accounts (9,000-10,000 counters); currently only 10-15% accounts tied up covering ~25-30% counters; full-time team now executing; target completion by April end
items.quote: Now what we've done is post this McKinsey document, we have 9 points to work out account - wise or -- account-wise. Account is what? Suppose there is an account called Reliance, Reliance has 500 counters, or there could be a single owner-driven account, which has single dealer or -- sorry, single shop or you migh t have 2 shops, et c. These tie-ups are not done with all. The tie - ups are only don

items.statement: Logistics cost tower with A&M targeting 15-20% savings on INR150-175 cr logistics spend; combined with material cost, scheme rationalisation, e-com and marketing initiatives to deliver double-digit margins
items.quote: Then comes logistics cost, which we are working with A&M and the logistics tower is being built. The logistics tower will have to control INR150 crores on logistics cost, INR150 crores or INR175 crores on logistics cost. We expect approximately 15% to 20% there. All of these things together is going to give us double-digit margin.

items.statement: Refrigerator: product feedback okay but cost innovation needed; channel wanted higher-end models first, not DC; no new capex, evaluating CKD imports. AC: push higher tonnage/premium; fix fit-finish/remote issues; improve brand recall and pr
items.quote: The one thing in refrigerator, which has come out clearly is that IFB should not have gone for DC, but should have gone for higher-end product first. And the thing with that is -- the thing with that if we had come out with the higher-end product like what Liebherr has come out with, for example, then placement would it have been difficult or not in the counters.

items.statement: Home Appliances targeting >20% CAGR; internal 3-year plan: no category below 10% share, double top-load share; exponential growth focus; M&A evaluated (57 companies reviewed) but deferred on valuation
items.quote: In no category should we be below 10% market share, point 1. In no category and especially in washer, etc., our market share should grow significantly from wherever we are today. We are already -- suppose in top loader, we are at hypothetically, whatever share we are at, we should get double the share, etc.

items.statement: New 12/13 kg top-load washers by September, 14 kg by November/December; full premium lineup ready by December; aim to benchmark internationally
items.quote: Sir, on the 14 kg we should be -- 12 kg and 13 kg will be there in September and 14 kg, we should be there in November or December.

items.statement: Government working with IFB on BIS standards for AC motors to counter Chinese imports; Atmanirbhar push expected to boost domestic motor demand
items.quote: And government of India has still not done the BIS thing on motor as yet. Now we started working with the ministry to impose the BIS standards also whilst that is going on, because there is no standard for this. So government is working with us on this.

items.statement: AC motor market 5-10 million units; must achieve >10% margin to be viable; competing with Chinese cost innovation; targeting Voltas, Blue Star, Bosch, Samsung for non-captive sales (ideal 60% external)
items.quote: The Chinese have done it. The Chinese are very, very good at cost innovation. So we have to compete with the Chinese, and we have to become better than them. There's no point in all Indian companies saying the Chinese prices are very low. We have to compete with them.

items.statement: Copper at ~INR12,000-13,000 LME, USD ~INR90; forex/commodity headwinds may persist; no forward guidance on Q4 impact; scenario planning initiated for further commodity spikes
items.quote: If you look at January, the rupee, except the last 2 days, it has again appreciated. But rupee was still around INR90 and copper was in excess of 12,000 LME. So there was not much change in January with respect to quarter 3.

items.statement: Scheme/promotion costs increased in Q3 (cashbacks, free kits); rationalisation started with volume-linked payouts to channel partners; benefits expected Q4 and Q1 FY27
items.quote: During the quarter, we had given higher promotion scheme per customer like cash back, free IFB essential kits. This has increased the cost of schemes.

items.statement: Evaluated 57 auto-component companies for M&A; several good targets but expensive; some deals signed but sellers backed out; financial prudence maintained
items.quote: We chose not to buy out of financial prudence. Many of the companies were extremely good, but they were very expensive. And some we did the deal and then they backed out by saying other things, etc. We had to back out, sorry.

items.statement: Front-load washing machine market share ~25%+ (addressable); top-load ~9.6-10%; AC split market share ~3-3.5%
items.quote: The market share in terms of front load addressable market share is touching around 25% plus. And in top loader, it is -- it was 9.6% or 10%.

items.statement: Exceptional item INR13.38 cr recognised for Labour Code liability (notified 21 Nov 2025); reduced Q3 PBT to INR31.9 cr from INR45.3 cr
items.quote: In this quarter, an incremental liability of INR13.38 crores have been recognized as an exceptional item, which is in line with Labour Code notified by the Government of India on November 21, 2025.

items.statement: TBDIT margin guided range 15-17%
items.quote: TBDIT margin is within the guided range of 15-17%.

items.statement: Operating margins expected to remain within guided range
items.quote: Operating margins are expected to remain within the guided range.

items.statement: Double-digit volume growth expected; value growth 4-5% below volume
items.quote: We should be able to definitely go into the volume, double-digit volume growth happening. As far as value growth are concerned, I think the differential will remain in the extent of 4-5%, so if the volume growth goes up to, say, 12-13%, then the value growth should be in the range of 7-8%.

items.statement: Demand improving month-on-month: Oct negative, Nov slightly positive, Dec mid-single-digit, Jan similar
items.quote: October was negative, you know, and which I had indicated in the last time we met, you know, here with all of you. November did have a slight positive. And then December was better than that in mid-single-digit type of a growth rate, and that is where we are in January as well.

items.statement: Early signs of gradual improvement; Oct negative, Nov slightly positive, Dec more positive, Jan slightly more positive
items.quote: Demand conditions continue to be closely monitored with early signs of gradual improvement. So, October was negative, November slightly positive, December more positive, January slightly more positive than December, so it's improving month on month.

items.statement: Gross margin 41.2%, highest in 15 quarters; EBITDA margin 16.1% within guided 15-17% range
items.quote: In fact, this quarter, it has been the highest in the last 15-odd quarters, barring quarter 4 of last year, which was matched at 41.2%. This quarter, too, it is at 41.2%. At the EBITDA level. Of course, it is at 16.1, largely because of the scale effect.

items.statement: Value-volume gap ~8% split: mix 3-3.5%, price cuts 2-2.5%, painter spends 1.5%
items.quote: 3-3.5%, you know, on account of the low-value, high-volume products selling much more, than other products.  The… about 2% to 2.5% were on account of direct price drops which were there, which we took in the low-end emulsions last year, which is still impacting. As I said, till January, this impact was there.  From February onwards, that weans off.  The third part which was there is we increase

items.statement: Anti-dumping duty on TiO2 removed; final court order received, partial refund obtained, rest applied for
items.quote: Anti-dumping duty, you know, yeah, we did fight this case, and we won this battle in the court. And, the government... the court has given a judgment that, you know, it needs to be given back. So we've got part of the money back. The other part we have applied for, and we should get back that money also, in form of the anti-dumping. As of now, there is no anti-dumping duty on titanium dioxide.

items.statement: Economy emulsion, textures, tile adhesives driving volume; premium/luxury muted in East; new launches: Color Plus, Silk Metallics, DamShield
items.quote: Higher share of economic emulsion, textures, and tile adhesives, coupled with price corrections taken in financial year 25 in the economy emulsion segment. The two together had that impact of volume growth being relatively stable, but value growth being at 0.4%.

items.statement: Construction chemicals, wood coatings, premium emulsions growing faster than company average; urban markets with investments outperforming
items.quote: Well, you know, some of the products, you know, as we have always said, you know, construction, chemical, waterproofing, wood coatings, some of our emulsants, you know, in the premium category are doing quite well, much better than the categories itself, and overall growth rate of the company. And in some regions, some of the urban markets where we have invested have started doing better than what

items.statement: Dealer network expansion: 2,500+ color bank machines installed; store count >1,800
items.quote: The dealer network expansion continued during the quarter. Driven by installation of 2,500 plus color bank machines. Which is, you know, what we had indicated that we will possibly do, and enhancing presence through addition of stores, and currently the store numbers are in excess of 1,800 stores across the country.

items.statement: Main challenger growth stabilizing at 7-12% vs earlier 35-40%; trade schemes stable; price gap narrowed
items.quote: It remains very stable now, you know, more or less, you know, the main player, remains at a stable point now. In terms of competitive intensity. It's not increasing, it's not decreasing, it is at a stable level. Month on month, we see the values remaining very similar, you know, to that category, and, you know, on a quarterly basis, if you look at it, there is no major gains happening. Yes, there

items.statement: Minor market share loss ~0.2% (from 19.5-19.6% to ~19.4%); gains mostly to Birla; competitor low base effect
items.quote: It's a minor share loss, you know. We were at 19.5, 19.6, it would have probably gone down to 19.4. Overall, 0.2% loss. across, you know, various markets, not as if, you know, we have dropped by 2% or something, you know. So, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3 here and there.

items.statement: Two new factories planned: Panagar and Odisha, total investment Rs 1,800-2,000 crore
items.quote: As of now, we have plans for two factories, one in Panagar and one in Urissa. Both of which together is an investment of about 1,800 to 2,000 crore.

items.statement: Resin facility at Hindupur for solvent-based production (industrial & decorative) to support automotive, protective, general industrial growth
items.quote: this is basically for solvent-based production, which we have start, you know, which we are going to start in Hindu Pur. We are expanding there in our southern plant. It is meant for industrial paint, also for decorative. More so for industrial, and also a little bit for decorative paint.

items.statement: Stock buildup during extended monsoon liquidated Nov-Jan; replenishment sales to improve Feb-Mar
items.quote: It did pick up, but not to the extent that we would have loved to see. Possibly also that, you know, while the rains, which was elongated quite a lot, we kept, you know, pumping material into the dealer's shelves, so there was some amount of stock buildup which happened. Which got liquidated in the period between November and January.

items.statement: Consolidated net cash improved from Rs 689 cr (Mar'25) to Rs 918 cr (Dec'25)
items.quote: Net cash position consolidated has improved. From about 689 crore in March 25, to 918 crore in December 26.

items.statement: No buyback plans at present; free cash flow to fund two new factories; small acquisition opportunities evaluated
items.quote: As of now, we have plans for two factories, one in Panagar and one in Urissa.  Both of which together is an investment of about 1,800 to 2,000 crore. So, it will absorb the free cash flow that is there. We already have about 900 plus crores in our books, and as you said, you know, about 1400 crore might be generated in the next 2 years.  So this will be consumed, a large part of it, in these two

items.statement: Standalone volume growth 8.5%, value growth 0.4% in Q3; 9M volume CAGR 8-10.7% over 2-4 years
items.quote: Standalone, if you look at the performance, 8.5% volume growth. The value growth, relatively much more muted at 0.4%.

items.statement: Consolidated revenue +0.3% YoY, EBITDA -0.2% YoY in Q3; 9M revenue +1.9%, EBITDA -5.4%
items.quote: Similarly, consolidated is very similar to standalone, at 0.3% in terms of top line, and minus 0.2% in terms of bottom line. And on a YTD basis, it is at 1.9% value growth, and minus 5.4% in terms of EBITDA growth.

items.statement: Geopolitical uncertainty, forex volatility, evolving tariff dynamics may pose near to medium-term volatility
items.quote: Geopolitical uncertainty, forex volatility, and evolving tariff dynamics may pose Near to medium-term volatility.

items.statement: ESG score 64 from NSE, leader among Indian paint peers; corporate office LEED Platinum certified Dec 2025
items.quote: Esg excellence at Berger Paints with a score of 64 across ESG parameters given by NSE. Score is a leader amongst the peers within India in the paint domain. We also got, you know, our corporate office was LEED Platinum certified. We got the certificate in last month, it's December 2025.

items.statement: Management reaffirms mid-term targets and will not provide new FY27 guidance
items.quote: No. We will stick with the guidance that we have given for the midterm. I think right now, we remain very focused on executing all the actions that we have outlined and sort of continue towards that trajectory.

items.statement: FY26 capex estimated at Rs 1,100 crore, higher than earlier Rs 1,000 crore guidance due to MMA, DCB and PEDA expansions
items.quote: Driven by some fast -track expansion initiatives for MMA, DCB and addition of PEDA capacity amongst few other new initiatives taken up in the year, the CAPEX for the year is estimated to be about Rs. 1,100 crs, a tad more than our earlier guided CAPEX of about Rs. 1,000 crs.

items.statement: FY27 capex expected to be significantly lower as Zone 4 commercialisation completes in CY26 and no other large projects in pipeline
items.quote: With Zone IV getting commercialised in CY26, and that there are no other large projects in the pipeline, we anticipate the CAPEX for FY27 to be significantly lower.

items.statement: Zone 4 total capex estimated at Rs 1,600-1,800 crore, bulk deployed by end of FY26 with Rs 300-400 crore spillover to FY27
items.quote: The total CAPEX on Zone 4 would be in the range of INR1,600 crore to INR1,800 crore. Bulk of that would be deployed by the end of this year. Hardly sort of INR300 crore to INR400 crore would be left for the next year.

items.statement: MMA capacity being debottlenecked from 290+ KT to 360 KT by end of Q4 FY26
items.quote: Given the fast -growing business environment for this segment, we have taken steadfast measures to further scale up the capacities from about 290+KT to about 360 KT and expect the same to be available by end of this fiscal i.e., Q4FY26.

items.statement: DCB capacity being debottlenecked from 120 to 140 KTPA to capture growth in PPS for EV segment
items.quote: We have also started debottlenecking efforts to increase DCB capacity from 120 to 140 KTPA to capture incremental growth opportunities in this (DCB) segment.

items.statement: Zone 4 MPP, Chloro toluene and downstream process blocks to be commissioned in phased manner during CY26 using indigenous technology
items.quote: During the current calendar year, we expect the upcoming MPP, Chloro toluene and downstream process blocks to be commissioned in a phased manner. Notably, we are commissioning these projects using our own in-house, indigenous technology.

items.statement: Superform JV commissioning expected in Q1 FY27 with revenue potential of Rs 300-400 crore, focused on agrochemical, paints and coatings applications
items.quote: The revenue potential as we declared when the JV was announced was in the range of around INR300 crore to INR400 crore or so. The end-use application was agrochemical.

items.statement: RESL JV construction commenced previous quarter, commissioning expected in H1 FY27
items.quote: The project is progressing well as planned and we anticipate the JV to be ready for commissioning in H1FY27.

items.statement: MMA volumes robust supported by strong demand and favourable feedstock spreads; US market volumes resumed and expected to stabilise
items.quote: Volumes have been robust, supported by strong demand and favourable feedstock spreads. While U.S. market volumes have resumed and are expected to stabilise, we continue to develop alternative markets, with focus on Europe.

items.statement: PDCB demand uptick driven by PPS growth in EV segment; PDA product chains face volume and pricing pressure due to US market dependency
items.quote: PDCB demand saw an uptick driven by PPS growth in the EV segment while PDA product chains continued to face volume and pricing pressure due to large dependency on the US market.

items.statement: EBITDA surged to Rs 323 crore, up 11% QoQ; one-time Rs 15 crore exceptional expense for new labour code implementation
items.quote: As a result, EBITDA surged to Rs. 323 crore, marking a 11% Q -o-Q increase. The company has provided for a one -time impact on account of implementation of the new labour code to the extent of Rs 15 crs as an exceptional expenses for the period.

items.statement: China anti-involution strategy and VAT subsidy removal expected to drive margin improvement in agrochemicals and pharmaceuticals over medium term
items.quote: The current evolving China anti -involution tariff stance is expected to drive margin improvement in these products over the medium time period.

items.statement: NCB chain pricing increased 7-10% within days after China removed 13% VAT rebate on exports
items.quote: The only impact where it was immediately visible for us was in NCB chain, right, where pricing went up within a span of a few days by almost 7% -10%.

items.statement: Exports constituted 65% of total revenue in Q3 FY26, highest ever in both percentage and absolute terms
items.quote: Exports for the period constituted about 65% of the total revenues for the company, the highest both in terms of percentage share and also in absolute basis.

items.statement: Increase in exports led to higher working capital and marginal increase in debt and interest costs
items.quote: Further the increase in exports has resulted in an increase in working capital and as a res ult the debt and interest costs have increased marginally

items.statement: Operating cash flow for 9 months FY26 in range of Rs 500-600 crore
items.quote: The operating cash flow for 9 months and the EBITDA was around in the range of around INR500 crore to INR600-odd crore roughly.

items.statement: India-EU FTA concluded, expected to generate large growth opportunities for exports and strategic partnerships in high-end specialty chemicals in mid-to-long term
items.quote: First, India rec ently concluded the India - EU Free Trade Agreement (FTA). While the near -term impact of the deal may be limited, this landmark deal is expected to generate large growth opportunities for exports and strategic partnership possibilities in high end specialty chemicals in the mid-to-long term.

items.statement: US-India trade deal announced, provides relief from tariff headwinds and expected to boost US business
items.quote: And lastly, while we were managing to navigate U.S. tariff headwinds, the recently announced US -India Trade deal provides a sigh of relief and is expected to boost the business in the US in coming times.

items.statement: MMA expected to settle at 30-40% of portfolio over 2-3 years as Zone 4 commissions; currently diversifying geography, customers and applications
items.quote: We feel MMA will ultimately settle anywhere between 30% to 40% of our portfolio, right, if you take a 2 -3 year's outlook and I think we continue to maintain that strategic stance.

items.statement: Agrochemicals at 17-18% of revenue on 9-month basis, potential to reach 20%+ as Zone 4 commissions; volumes stable but margins under pressure from Chinese dumping
items.quote: It remains at a 17%, 18% odd level, and it has all the potential sort of possibility to reach the number that you were targeting around 20 -odd percentage, especially as the Zone 4 also gets commissioned, it will even potentially cross that number.

items.statement: PDA utilisation impacted by US tariffs on two largest customers; expected to improve with US-India trade deal settlement
items.quote: It was one of the value chains, which was mostly impacted due to U.S. tariffs because the 2 largest customers actually consume this product in U.S. With the settlement of the U.S.-India trade deal now, we expect utilizations to improve.

items.statement: Expect 12-15% volume growth in FY27 driven by new projects
items.quote: So probably we can expect around 12% to 15% volume growth in FY '27 with both the projects going smooth, the greenfield projects I'm talking about.

items.statement: Target 12-13% EBITDA margin initially, then 14-15% steady state
items.quote: So first we'll come there, 12% to 13%. And then from there, the ideal steady-state margins when everything starts going smoothly, should be somewhere in 14% to 15% range.

items.statement: Expect INR 150-200 crores capex per year for next 2 years
items.quote: Having said that, I would still maintain that around INR 150 crores to INR 200 crores of c apex you can expect for the next 2 years each, considering the formulation, oncology expansion and all the ideas I just spoke about

items.statement: Sayakha facility to reach 50% utilization by March-April 2026, 75% in subsequent quarter
items.quote: Immediately in this current quarter, March quarter, we are planning to ramp up to around 50% utilization. And then in the subsequent quarter, we are planning 75% utilization of the

items.statement: Salicylic acid plant targets 1,000 tons per month within 12 months
items.quote: But within 12 months, probably we should try to hit that 1,000 tons per month mark. That should be our target.

items.statement: Standalone API gross margin of 36% achievable in FY27

items.statement: Oncology formulation capacity 300 million pills, 90% in general plant

items.statement: Q3 FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin 9.3%, down from 11.2% YoY
items.quote: EBITDA stood at INR 56.3 crores versus INR 62.3 crores in Q3 FY '25, down 10% on Y-o-Y basis, with EBITDA margin at 9.3%.

items.statement: Q3 FY26 consolidated gross margin ~35.9%, impacted 1% by inventory sales

items.statement: Sayakha and salicylic plants caused INR 8-8.5 crores EBITDA drag in Q3
items.quote: So both these included, probably at the EBITDA level, it could have created a drag of roughly INR8 crores, INR 8.5 crores

items.statement: 7% volume growth in standalone business YoY, negative 5% rate variance

items.statement: Weaker antibiotic demand reduced market pull and utilization

items.statement: January sales show encouraging trend, inflection point reached
items.quote: January month sales shows a trend which is encouraging and providing confidence in a more positive trajectory for coming quarters.

items.statement: Formulations revenue INR 76.6 crores, up 58% YoY, exports 67%

items.statement: API portfolio: antibiotic 35.1%, antiprotozoal 19.8%, anti-inflammatory 12.9%, antidiabetic 16.6%, antifungal 12.2%

items.statement: EU GMP approval received for both oncology and general OSD facilities at Baddi
items.quote: Yes, it's for the general Talvin capsule facility as well as the oncology facility. So it was in joint inspection for both the facilities. And now we have EU GMP for both the oncology as well as the general oral solid side.

items.statement: US FDA audit planned for metformin facility, US DMF filing in process
items.quote: The first step is that we are going for U.S. FDA approval for the metformin. We have already prepared a U.S. DMF. We are in the process of filing it, and we'll try to trigger the audit in the coming year and take it from there.

items.statement: INR 30 crores sales from finished goods inventory in Q3, impacting gross margin by 1%
items.quote: If you see the numbers, around INR 30 crores of sales has come from the existing stocks and not because of the fresh production. And because of that, we have estimated that roughly it would have impacted around 1% in the gross margins

items.statement: Expect steady licensing income run rate of ~INR150 crores annually
items.quote: we will see a steady run rate of close to INR150-odd crores licensing income every year.

items.statement: Formulation base revenue of INR150+ crores per quarter sustainable for upcoming quarters
items.quote: It can be assumed at least for upcoming quarters.

items.statement: Albumin India commercialization possible in FY28
items.quote: FY '28 commercialization in India, yes, it's very much possible for us as on today.

items.statement: ADC biosimilar human studies to start in FY27 for global market
items.quote: Its for Global, and to update you, majorly all our products, in the Biologics side are for global market.

items.statement: Peptide manufacturing capacity capex of ~INR40 crores to complete in H2 FY27
items.quote: We are planning to invest close to INR40 crores, for this peptide facility.

items.statement: Peptide facility capacity >100 kg for semaglutide
items.quote: Yes, we can do more than 100 kgs.

items.statement: Non-oncology API capacity not fully utilized; room for growth in upcoming quarters

items.statement: New oral solid formulation line commissioned for next FY revenue
items.quote: Recently, we have also commissioned a new oral solid line, which will be available, and will help us in generating additional revenues in the next financial year.

items.statement: NorUDCA has strong order book for coming quarters with 3 marketing partners
items.quote: the strong initial reception that this product has received has translated into a very healthy order book for the coming quarters as well.

items.statement: NorUDCA growth expectations advanced from Q1 FY27 to Q4 FY26
items.quote: whatever growth we were expecting to start from Q1, we would see that in Q4FY26 itself.

items.statement: Adjusted ROCE (ex-Biologics/NBE) improved from 3.5% FY23 to >17% in 9M FY26
items.quote: Our adjusted ROCE, excluding investments made in our high-growth potential businesses like Biologics and NBE, we have seen significant improvement from 3.5% in FY '23 to over 17% in the first 9 months period.

items.statement: Interest outgo reduced YoY and stabilized at current quarter run rate
items.quote: Our interest outgo has seen reduction year -on-year, and we believe it has now stabilized at the current quarter run rate for the near future.

items.statement: Nilotinib innovator still controls ~40% Europe market; competition not significant
items.quote: Even today, if you see, we have launched Nilotinib in Europe from many quarters. Even today, innovator controls almost 40% market in Europe.

items.statement: Exclusive CDMO partner for Unicycive NCE program with PDUFA date June 29, 2026
items.quote: Unicycive Therapeutics has resubmitted the filing to FDA and they have received PDUFA date of June 29, 2026.

items.statement: mAbTree product (exclusive CDMO) received orphan drug designation for 2 indications
items.quote: mAbTree product, for which we are exclusive CDMO partner, the product has received orphan drug designation for 2 different indications.

items.statement: US FDA CAPA responses submitted for Jadcherla; awaiting revert
items.quote: after the U.S. FDA inspection, we have finished all the CAPA, and CAPA responses are submitted to U.S. FDA. Now, we are waiting for revert from U.S. FDA.

items.statement: Albumin global CT protocol approval received; Europe IMPD submission targeted Q4 FY26
items.quote: the global CT clinical trial protocol approval is received in current quarter, and IMPD submission for Europe is targeted in Q4 FY '26.

items.statement: Net debt INR625 crores as of Dec 31; debt-equity ~0.25-0.26; no plan to increase borrowing
items.quote: as on 31st December, our net debt was about INR625 crores.

items.statement: Highest ever quarterly revenue INR411 crores (+28% YoY); 9M INR1,110 crores (+14%)
items.quote: We have reported the highest ever quarterly revenue of INR411 crores, recording a growth of 28% year-on-year, whereas our 9 months revenue were at INR1,110 crores, growing at 14%.

items.statement: Highest ever quarterly EBITDA INR115 crores (+41% YoY)
items.quote: We also reported our highest ever quarterly EBITDA at INR115 crores as compared to INR82 crores in Q3 of FY '25, reflecting a robust growth of 41%.

items.statement: Formulation revenue INR177 crores (+50% YoY); ex-licensing base business +104% QoQ, +83% 9M
items.quote: the Formulation revenues for the quarter were at INR177 crores, growing at 50% year -on-year. And ex -licensing income, the base business reported a robust growth in the revenue of 104% quarter -on-quarter and 83% for the 9 months period.

items.statement: API business (incl. captive) grew 11% YoY to INR243 crores; 9M grew 17% to INR725 crores
items.quote: including the captive business, the API business witnessed a robust growth of 11% from INR218 crores in third quarter of previous year to INR243 crores in the current year.

items.quote: RoW is a purely tender-driven supplies. And sometimes, there are a few tender supplies which we would have done in 1 quarter and that is supplied for like 2 quarters.

items.quote: during the quarter, we also had an exceptional item amounting to INR13 crores pre-tax on account of change in Labour Code implemented by the Government of India.

items.statement: ADC GMP facility (first in India with integrated payload/linker/conjugation) to commission Q4 FY26
items.quote: GMP facility for our ADC manufacturing, we are planning to commission in Q4 FY '26. It will be first of its kind ADC manufacturing facility in India with integrated payload linker and conjugation facility.

items.statement: Management maintains medium-to-long-term adjusted EBITDA guidance of 32% to 33% at consolidated level
items.quote: We have been maintaining that stand all throughout, and I request you to do it. We have had a great Adjusted EBITDA percentage in this quarter, but rather than taking that as a guidance, we will continue with our guidance of 32%, 33% adjusted EBITDA for the mid- to long-term basis for the company.

items.statement: Music segment medium-to-long-term growth guidance maintained at 21% to 23% annually
items.quote: We continue with our guidance of 21% to 23% growth in the medium to long term in music segment and an annual adjusted EBITDA guidance of 32% to 33%.

items.statement: Full-year FY26 music revenue growth guidance of 17% to 18% reiterated
items.quote: At the end of Q2, we had given a guidance of 17% to 18% music revenue growth by the end of the year. At the end of 9 months, we are sitting on 18% growth on a 9-month basis. We are still hopeful to go back and maintain our guidance of 17% to 18% on a full-year basis when we end Q4.

items.statement: Events business targets high single-digit margin percentage in steady state over 2-3 years

On a margin basis, it will look very small, but events business by very nature is a very high IRR business because the cash gets deployed at best for 15 to 20 days.

items.statement: New music content spend for FY26 guided at INR 275-300 crores, down from earlier plan due to film release delays
items.quote: Overall, our spend for the new content this year will be in the space at INR 275 crores to INR 300 crores. This has come down compared to what we had earlier planned because many of the films that we had planned for the year, their releases got pushed to the next financial year.

items.statement: Three-year new music content investment guidance of INR 1,000 crores over FY25-27 includes Bhansali Productions music acquisitions
items.quote: Our music investment on newer content, we have given a guidance of around INR 1,000 crores over financial year '25, '26 and '27. After that, it's not that we will stop investing in newer music. We need to keep your company completely future-proof.

items.quote: Overall company released 1,100-odd original and premium recreations across Hindi, Bhojpuri, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Marathi and Bengali languages. And this also includes Chhattisgarhi and Odia.

items.quote: Something that used to take 10 to 12 days through the earlier possible tools or if we had to shoot used to take up to 15 days, including editing, can now easily be done in less than 3 days. And the way AI generation tools are moving, we like to believe this process should be completed in 1, 1.5 day within a year or so.

items.statement: Artist management roster grew to 270+ artists with 300M+ followers across Instagram and YouTube; 60 new artists added in Q3 FY26

items.quote: Even now if you see at the end of this quarter, we have, what, close to INR 15 crores, assets which is locked into the events vertical. Events vertical does not ever have any major cash that gets locked there because you the very nature is that you put the money in, the capital gets rotated right now within 30 to 40 days, one gets out.

items.quote: Our understanding of the next few years' plans is that the combination of the capital infusion done by Saregama and Bhansali Productions and this unique ability Bhansali Productions has that they can go to a digital platform and pre-sell the rights even right at the script stage and pick up massive advances from them. The combination of these two will come very, very handy for them to go back and

items.quote: There are only a few artists in this country. items.quote: Industry is growing anything between 5% to 8% year-on-year basis. Remaining growth that is coming in is coming in because we are investing heavily in newer content and our market share is going up.

items.quote: In this quarter, we have also taken the impact on account of the new Labour Code of around INR 7 crores, which is a one-time non-cash exceptional item.

items.quote: As shared earlier, with the acquisition of a minority stake in SLB, we plan to wind down our in- house movie business. items.quote: If you see this quarter's EBITDA percentage sitting at 46%. Now, these are aberrations that keep on happening. 46% cannot be offered right now quarter - on-quarter. items.quote: So, we had Diljit show during this quarter. We had Himesh shows during this quarter and we had some of the stand up comedy that we people did during this quarter.

items.statement: Unallocable expenditure increase due to lower interest income as surplus funds deployed for business purposes
items.quote: So if you see, this is basically due to the decrease in the other income, which is interest income, which we were having surplus fund, which we have invested in FDs and mutual funds. items.statement: Management guides long-term revenue growth at 1.4-1.5x industry production growth on an annual basis

items.quote: The project entails fresh capital expenditure of INR 764 crores to be deployed in a phased manner over the next 3 years to 4 years.

items.quote: the roughly impact is around 6% to 7% for aluminum commodity price, which has obviously increased, so which will have some impact, maybe around 5%, 6% in terms of overall revenues for casting domain.

items.quote: The 4-wheeler switching business under Uno Minda also outperformed the industry, supported by a steady increase in kit value per vehicle as OEMs increasingly adopt advanced feature switch systems.

items.statement: Targeting import substitution for LPDC alloy wheels; discussions encouraging with players currently importing wheels

items.quote: If you see our group revenues overall, the 9-month physical exports have been in the range of INR 500 crores, INR 600 crores physically from India plus the overseas sales.

items.statement: Finance costs increased to INR 53 cr due to higher borrowings for capex and incremental working capital needs
items.quote: Finance costs during the quarter increased to INR 53 crores, largely reflecting higher borrowings to support our ongoing capital expenditure program, incremental working capital needs, etcetera.

items.statement: Net debt INR 2,298 cr (Dec 31) vs INR 2,091 cr (Mar 31); net debt/equity 0.33x; ROCE 18% on annualized 9M profits (includes non-deployed capex)
items.quote: Our net debt as of December end was at INR 2,298 crores compared to INR 2,091 crores as on March 31, 2025. Our net debt to equity as at 31st December '25 stood healthy at 0.33.

items.statement: Board declared interim dividend of INR 0.9/share, 20% higher than last year's interim dividend

items.quote: EV 2-wheel sales grew by 7% to 3.6 lakh units. However, the penetration levels have declined to 5.1%, which was 5.6% in Q3 FY '25 and 7.76% in Q2 FY '26.

items.statement: Labour code financial impact depends on central/state rules notification and further clarifications; commodity pass-through has time lag (quarterly/half-yearly/annual)

items.statement: Green power expected to exceed 40% of total energy consumption with approved INR 6.5 cr investment in SPV for open access wind/solar in Gujarat

items.quote: The construction of a new greenfield facility for high-voltage EV powertrain components under our potential JV with Inovance is progressing as per schedule with Phase 1 commissioning targeted in FY '27.

items.statement: Capex plan for FY27 to be finalized in next 5-6 weeks; better visibility to be shared in annual results call (May)
items.quote: maybe we'll be able to give you better color as we always do in our May con-call because we just started our budgeting exercise, and hopefully, we should be over by next 5 weeks to 6 weeks.

items.statement: Capacity utilization ranges 75-95% across businesses; seating, sensors, controllers growing strongly but capacity expansion only when existing facilities fully debottlenecked

items.statement: Sensors & ADAS scaling: camera module lines in commercial production with Indian OEMs; new camera module order from Japanese PV OEM

items.statement: PV industry production 1.4M units (+19% YoY); domestic PV sales 1.28M (highest ever Q3); 2-wheeler production ~6.8M (+15% YoY); scooters +23%, motorcycles +12%

items.statement: Anchor customers secured for 4-wheeler EV powertrain and sunroof (FY28); order book builds gradually after start of production
items.quote: we already have an anchor customer for both these businesses. And normally, what happens is you start the business with an anchor customer. And then once the operations start, then you gradually try and get more business from other customers

items.quote: Power and fuel was around higher by around INR 13-odd crores. Then because of volumes, your freights and other overheads were higher by around INR 11 crores, INR 12 crores.

items.statement: 4-wheeler alloy wheel asset turn ~1.2-1.3x in DPR; margins higher than company average to achieve target ROCE
items.quote: The asset turn in this DPR, what we have prepared is obviously going to be around 1.2 to 1.3. And as you move forward, it improves a little bit with debottlenecking, etcetera, etcetera.
