items.quote: So, with the heavy, heavy competition that we have in this industry, I do feel that profitability will also grow, but it will grow modestly. I do not think you will have breakthrough growths in profitability.

items.quote: At this point in time, we are not really working on that area yet. We will start to work on that area. But, I see there is plenty of useful cash that we can do. items.statement: Competitive intensity remains very high with 10-12 major players plus 15-20 others; new brands use pricing/discounting to gain share

items.quote: I can assure you that all future ESOP plans that are given to the top leadership of the Company, which are performance-based, will not be anything to do with corporation. items.quote: Yes, I do commit on this call that we will have the calls every quarter. Yes, so that is a commitment.

items.quote: Given so many variables -- pricing, regulatory, market, P4G cost programs – it is difficult for me to say this will be the profit or that will be the profit. Directionally, it is an unusual year, that is all.

items.quote: So, the portfolio position for it will be revenue driver, not so much a profit driver, because the margins in an air conditioner typically for the industry are lower than the margins for refrigerators and washers. items.quote: Last year Q3 was when the RPO prices started going up, if you will remember, yes. Q3 and Q4 when RPO prices started shooting up. And then we started initiating the price correction activities from Q4 and Q1.

items.quote: So right now, it's high single. And see, we know that every quarter, this is moving up, right? So what we will end up with a high single salience. I think this certainly will move very quickly maybe to the early teens or twins, right, is how we see this going forward in FY '27.

items.quote: You would have heard the announcement that we've hired a new CMO, who's going to be the CMO for all the businesses, except Dairy and international business.

items.quote: In Q4, I'm expecting the growth momentum to continue. Inquiries are better. Conversions are better, bookings are good.

items.quote: Domestic sales remained healthy across all 3 months with a double-digit growth, supporting strong year-to-date growth, driven by sustained retail traction.

items.quote: We continue to maintain a strong growth momentum in retail volume across international markets like Brazil, Argentina and Thailand.

items.statement: Jal Jeevan Mission allocation Rs. 67,670 crore in FY27 budget; timely disbursement would clear state dues to contractors
items.quote: For Jal Jeevan Mission, the budget has provided an allocation of Rs. 67,670 crore for FY27. In case the allocated funds are disbursed in timely manner to the states, it would be of a great help to clear the long outstanding dues to contractors by respective states and expedite the progress for faster commissioning.

items.statement: Land acquisition delays and recurrent bid due date extensions slowing NHAI awarding; uncertainty remains
items.quote: land being a state subject, the NH AI is also struggling to get the minimum land and remove all obstructions and all. But now they are streamlining the process, compensation, distribution, everything now they made it digital. So we expect land acquisition that will speed up

items.statement: EPC competition very high (20-25 bidders); HAM competition moderate; expected to reduce as awarding picks up and net worth criteria depletes bidders
items.quote: Now, you can say competition in HAM in the moderate condition, and EPC is very high.

items.statement: Expect margins to improve 10% Q-on-Q this quarter and a further 10-15% next quarter
items.quote: Yes, we definitely see some improvement quarter-by-quarter in the next 2 quarters. So we expect the margins to go up by at least 10% Q-on-Q this quarter and maybe a further 10% -- 10% to 15% next quarter.

items.statement: Odisha greenfield expansion of 1.5 lakh spindles with INR1,000 crore outlay, funded by term loan and internal accruals
items.quote: In the first phase of the expansion, 1.5 lakh spindles will be set up in the state of Odisha. This will be an approximately 40% increase over the existing spindle count to 3.79 lakhs. The total outlay would be approximately INR1,000 crores and be funded through a mixture of term loan and internal accruals.

items.statement: Odisha project commissioning to start by Q3 FY26, full ramp-up to 96-98% utilization by end of FY27
items.quote: We expect to start commissioning machines -- commissioning by the third quarter of this year. And I think it will take us 3 to 4 months to ramp it up and be at 96% to 98% of capacity utilization. We expect that to come by the end of next financial year.

items.statement: Odisha expansion expected to add INR1,200-1,300 crores in additional turnover
items.quote: So this is a INR1,000 crores project, which will give us a turnover of about INR1,200 crores to INR1,300 crores, so additional turnover.

items.statement: Q3 FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 45 bps YoY to 10.2%; 9M FY26 EBITDA margin up 59 bps to 10.8%
items.quote: Operational EBITDA for the Q3 FY '26 stood at INR65.6 crores as against INR59.2 crores in Q3 FY '25, a 10.8% increase on Y-o-Y basis. EBITDA margin was at 10.2%, expanded by 45 basis points on year-to-year.

items.statement: Sharp demand recovery from China and Bangladesh; U.S. and EU trade deals unlocking additional demand
items.quote: As the new year started, we have witnessed a sharp demand from China for cotton yarns after a long time. Bangladesh has been pretty consistent and resilient for us in spite of all the uncertainties in the market before the impending elections. This has helped in moving the spread upward as we speak. Further impetus has been given by long-awaited India-U.S.A deal, which has unlocked additional dema

items.statement: EU-India FTA finalized: duties on garments to move from 9-12% to 0% over 6-8 months; U.S. cotton may get duty-free access
items.quote: And with EU, of course, there is a substantial change in the duties because right now, most of our competing countries are paying 0% duty. And we were paying 12% -- 9% to 12% right now. And once this deal is formalized in the next 6 to 8 months, we are going to come back to 0% -- we are going to be also at 0%.

items.statement: Merger with garment and dyeing units to complete by March 31; garment revenue to grow 25-30% next year from INR200 crore base
items.quote: Yes, definitely, we are already on the job, and we expect to increase the turnover by at least 25% to 30% in next financial year. From INR200 crores, we wish to go to INR250 crores, INR260 crores.

items.statement: Geographic mix dynamic; shifting to higher-margin markets; domestic market preferred for certainty
items.quote: Ma'am, we are a very dynamic company. So we keep on switching our share. We are present in almost all the countries where cotton yarn goes, so we -- and we have good relations everywhere. So we keep on varying our percentage as per the market demand and where we can get better prices.

items.statement: Global capacity consolidation of 5-6 million spindles in last 2-3 years across Turkey, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Indonesia supporting pricing
items.quote: If you look around Turkey, Indonesia, China -- not China that much, but Pakistan and Bangladesh, there have been huge shutdowns. And India also, from -- I think as per the machinery suppliers, the capacities have come down by at least 5 million to 6 million spindles, maybe more.

items.statement: Capacity utilization at 96% in Q3 FY26, among highest in industry
items.quote: As of Q3 FY '26, we stand at capacity utilization of 96%, among the highest in the industry.

items.statement: Booking cycle 60-70 days; current sales at spreads ~INR20 higher than last quarter
items.quote: We, as a company, have -- we have a booking for 60 to 70 days. What I'm saying is what I'm selling today will be at a spread -- the spread will be about INR20 higher than what it was last quarter.

items.statement: Vision to become predominantly garment player in 5-10 years; fast-tracking garment expansion plans post trade deals
items.quote: Our vision is to be a predominantly garment house -- garment player in the next 5 to 10 years. This is just to give us a leverage and our know-how that we are acquiring these units, and we're going to scale them up as we learn more about the business.

items.statement: Cotton yarn prices increased INR20-25 over last 45 days due to demand recovery
items.quote: So there is no pressure on pricing right now. Rather prices have been going up since last 45 days. There's been an increase of almost INR20 to INR25 in the cotton yarn prices.

items.statement: Gross margin expansion in 9M FY26 driven by stable raw material prices, better inventory optimization and purchase management
items.quote: The expansion in gross profit margin was primarily driven by stable raw material prices throughout the period, which enabled better inventory optimization and improved purchase management.

items.statement: Domestic revenue grew 29% YoY in Q3 FY26 to INR324.7 crore; export revenue up 6% YoY in 9M FY26
items.quote: During the quarter, domestic revenue stood at INR324.7 crores compared to INR251.2 crores in Q3 FY '25, delivering a robust year-on-year growth of 29%.

items.statement: Full year FY26 guidance on track
items.quote: We remain bullish on the growth opportunities in domestic as well as in the international businesses and are on track to deliver our full year guidance.

items.statement: Domestic business YTD growth near 10%
items.quote: if we look at our YTD numbers, we have grown at close to 10%.

items.statement: Chronic segment growing high teens
items.quote: We have a high teens kind of growth that we are registering in our overall chronic segment.

items.statement: International sales grew 26.6% YoY in Q3
items.quote: International sales were at INR12,157 million with a Y-o-Y growth of 26.6%.

items.statement: Q3 EBITDA margin 22.2%
items.quote: EBITDA margin of 22.2% and EBITDA stands at INR8,280 million with a 9% Y-o-Y growth.

items.statement: MedTech EBITDA margin target 25% in 4-5 years
items.quote: In 4-5 years, both businesses will have an EBITDA margin of 25%.

items.statement: Occlutech EBITDA margin target 23-24% in 3 years
items.quote: our estimate is to have 10% EBITDA by FY '27, which will take us to around 23% to 24% in 3 years' time.

items.statement: Gross margin guidance similar with 0.5-1% variation
items.quote: as of now, we are looking at, say, a similar guidance on the gross margin, maybe 0.5 to 1 percentage basis points here and there.

items.statement: Occlutech revenue estimate INR600 cr in CY26, 14% CAGR for 5 years
items.quote: probably around INR600 crores, we are estimating in the calendar year '26. And then subsequently, we will grow that number up to INR780 crores in -- yes, approximately 14% CAGR about -- for the next 5 years.

items.statement: MedTech incremental investment INR200-300 cr over 3-4 years, mostly done
items.quote: more or less, maybe overall medtech .will take INR200 crores to INR300 crores more of investment in the next 3 to 4 years. Significant investment, I would say, is almost done.

items.statement: Occlutech manufacturing in Germany and Turkey, will continue
items.quote: The manufacturing facility, as I said, it will take time because it is also regulated. And already currently, it is in Germany and Turkey as well. And this m anufacturing facility will continue to operate

items.statement: Trade generic business flat YoY in Q3, lower single-digit YTD
items.quote: For the quarter, it was flat. For the YTD at YTD level, it was lower single-digit.

items.statement: Semaglutide day-one launch planned
items.quote: we're all getting ready for semaglutide launch also, which will be -- we are also geared up for day one entry into semaglutide.

items.statement: MIP impact on PenG derivatives estimated INR80-100 cr, partly offset by pricing
items.quote: it looks like overall close to, say, INR80 crores to INR100 crores impact, but some of this would get -- should get nullified by some of the market pricing because even our trade generic business, we have a big portfolio on that front. So we can pass it on to the customer.

items.statement: 4-5 months inventory of PenG derivatives held
items.quote: We have close to 4 to 5 months of inventory with regards to the number of days.

items.statement: Outperforming IPM in six therapies per IQVIA
items.quote: According to IQVIA data, we have outperformed IPM in six therapies, which is anti-infectives, which is our core, we are growing 1.4x. Vitamins and minerals, we are growing 2x of the market. Pain at 1.4x. Antidiabetic is 1.2x. But if I adjust for the GLP-1, it is more than 2x of the market. Respiratory 1.2x, and derma 1.8x.

items.statement: Domestic growth 100-150 bps above IPM
items.quote: I have always maintained that we will continue to grow at 100 to 150 basis points more than the IPM growth.

items.statement: Denosumab US entry end of 2026 due to Amgen litigation
items.quote: U.S. entry is going to be '26 end, hopefully. And Europe, we'll be entering very, very soon in the next couple of months.

items.statement: Occlutech debt INR450-500 cr at 10%, to be refinanced at 5-6% via corporate guarantee
items.quote: they have a loan also in their books of around INR450 crores to INR500 crores. The loan is currently at 10%. But yes, definitely, we have plans to reduce the interest loan since Alkem has such, say, cash equity in the market. So definitely, the PAT will also improve once the loan is supported by the corporate guarantee.

items.statement: No further large MedTech acquisitions planned
items.quote: coming to MedTech, I think more or less is done. We might look at something small, but nothing significant, for sure.

items.statement: Kaustav Banerjee has 26 years MedTech experience from Medtronic, St. Jude, Abbott, Zimmer Biomet
items.quote: I have spent around 26 years into MedTech. Starting with large three global companies, Medtronic, St. Jude, Abbott and then Zimmer Biomet.

items.statement: MedTech revenue target INR1,000 cr in 3-5 years with 20-25% EBITDA
items.quote: in the next 3 to 5 years, revenue could be around INR1,000 crores and EBITDA would be around, say, 20%, 22%, 25% would take higher.

items.statement: Occlutech payback 10 years without new products, lower with pipeline
items.quote: if you don't consider the additional portfolio, which we are going to launch or you don't consider LA, which is a big opportunity, the payback is around 10 years on this asset. But after considering LA or, say, a new set of products which can be launched under this platform, the payback will significantly be lower.

items.statement: Revised full-year FY26 guidance upward reflecting improved business outlook and stronger operating momentum
items.quote: We have revised our full year guidance for financial year '26, as mentioned in Slide number 7. The upward revision in FY '26 guidance reflects a materially improved business outlook and stronger-than-anticipated operating momentum.

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA grew 25% YoY to INR98 crores; EBITDA margin expanded from 56% to 66% of net revenue
items.quote: Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter came in at INR98 crores, an absolute growth of 25% year-over-year, reflecting improved operating leverages as volumes scaled up. The EBITDA as a percentage of net revenue also jumped from 56% to 66% on a year-over-year basis.

items.statement: Adjusted PAT grew 59% YoY to INR86 crores; PAT margin expanded from 39% to 58%
items.quote: Our adjusted PAT stood at INR86 crores, a growth of 59% year-over-year, supported by cost control, stable credit cost and higher contribution from value-added services. Our PAT margin has also jumped from 39% to 58%.

items.statement: Higher share of credit card and large ticket transactions; increased enterprise and institutional merchant participation; consistent SME and cooperative banking onboarding
items.quote: We are seeing higher share of credit card and large ticket transactions, increased participation from enterprise and institutional merchants, consistent onboarding across SMEs and cooperative banking networks.

items.statement: Received in-principle RBI license for prepaid payment instruments; secured IFSCA approval at GIFT City for cross-border payments; received RBI authorization for offline payment aggregation
items.quote: We received our in-principle RBI license for issuing prepaid payment instruments, enabling us to launch wallets, store value products and prepaid solutions in the near future under the CCAvenue ecosystem. We secured the IFSCA approval at GIFT City, which will allow us to participate directly in cross-border payments, escrow services and international merchant acquiring. We also received the RBI au

items.statement: International payment business gaining traction in UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Oman; GIFT City to provide strategic base for USD-denominated settlements and cross-border flows
items.quote: Our international payment business continued to gain traction. In the UAE and Saudi Arabia, the transaction volumes remain strong, supported by enterprise clients and platform integrations. In Oman, we are now working with multiple leading banks, expanding our role as a technology and payment infrastructure partner. GIFT City will provide us with a strategic base for U.S.-denominated settlements a

items.statement: Launched CCAvenue CommerceAI and PayCentral.ai for autonomous AI-agent-initiated transactions and compliance-ready auditable payment execution
items.quote: With the launch of CCAvenue CommerceAI and PayCentral.ai, we are enabling autonomous transaction initiated by verified AI agents and compliance-ready auditable payment execution.

items.statement: ResAvenue processed 768,107 room nights at average 8,534 room nights per day, crossing INR6,050 million for 3,500+ hotel properties
items.quote: This quarter, our ResAvenue platform enabled hotel room bookings of 768,107 room nights at an average of 8,534 room nights a day, crossing over INR6,050 million for our 3,500-plus hotel properties.

items.statement: Deliberately prioritizing volume-led growth and absolute profitability over headline take rates; net take rate decreased but EBITDA margin expanded due to operating leverage and cost efficiency
items.quote: As discussed earlier, we are concisely prioritizing volume-led growth and absolute profitability over headline take rates. This approach is already delivering stronger cash flows and operating leverage even in a competitive pricing environment.

items.statement: Investing in AI and platform infrastructure, Rediff, and regulatory readiness; capital allocation remains measured and return-driven
items.quote: This financial flexibilit y allows us to fund investments in AI and platform infrastructure and selectively invest in growth initiatives such as Rediff without stressing returns on or liquidity. Our capital allocation remains measured and return driven

items.statement: Redeploying workforce toward AI-first framework; hiring freeze on areas automatable by agents; significant shift in workforce mix toward task agents, orchestration agents, and decision agents
items.quote: There will be hiring freeze on many of the potential areas that can be automated using agents, a lot of manual tasks, reconciliations, onboarding, you would -- there will be -- and we believe that there is a significant shift happening even today because you would -- the kind of workforce that you would require in an AI-first framework is very different than what you would require in the past.

items.statement: UPI currently has zero MDR; if UPI becomes chargeable it would be beneficial; working with finance ministry on MDR for large merchants and government subvention growth
items.quote: Right now, MDR is at 0 right now for UPI, right? So the whole focus area is on all the other options that we have, other 199 options that we have to get the margins and to increase business on that front. But yes, of course, when the UPI becomes chargeable to even our offline and online, both can contribute significant margin if and where if the MDR ever comes in.

items.statement: Midpoint of revised FY26 guidance range achievable; management appropriately conservative; may invest more in branding and marketing if performance exceeds expectations
items.quote: I think the midpoint of that guidance range would, of course, be achievable in our opinion. And we have been appropriately conservative. We would like to -- if we are doing -- and if we find that we are doing better and larger, which is reasonable to also assume we'll be investing more in branding, marketing and some of the other activities.

items.statement: PayCentral.ai integrates across all payment aggregators' MCPs, not just CCAvenue; aims to become intelligence layer for money flows commanding few bps of total transaction volume
items.quote: So it integrates within the MCPs of all different payment aggregators and not just CCAvenue. So it auto routes transactions for success probability. It predicts the fraud, it disputes, it optimizes all the checkout flows and it negotiates routing and settlement logic and automates all this merchant reconciliation and collections.

items.statement: AI reduced payment failures by 9% in Q3 through intelligent routing across 200+ options and real-time fraud detection; structural gains already embedded, future gains model-driven
items.quote: AI is intelligent routing. So when we get a particular failure from a particular bank, right, and then we have the ability to route it through multiple other banks that we are working at in the back end. So intelligent AI-based system that we have implemented, which gauges on the success rate going down to as back as just the last 5 minutes, which calculates the best success rates, it can be intel

items.statement: Strong balance sheet with healthy cash flows from operations and low leverage; financial flexibility to fund AI and platform investments
items.quote: We continue to maintain a strong balance sheet with healthy cash flows from operations and low leverage. This financial flexibilit y allows us to fund investments in AI and platform infrastructure and selectively invest in growth initiatives such as Rediff without stressing returns on or

items.statement: Focus on absolute profitability and cash generation rather than headline take rate metrics; operating leverage improving as volumes scale
items.quote: Our focus remains on absolute profitability and cash generation rather than headline take rate metrics. Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter came in at INR98 crores, an absolute growth of 25% year-over-year, reflecting improved operating leverages as volumes scaled up.

items.statement: Corporate rebranding to AvenuesAI Limited reflects structural evolution into AI-native transaction infrastructure platform; full-stack regulated, data-rich, compounding ecosystem across Rediff, RediffOne, CCAvenue, Phronetic AI
items.quote: During the quarter, we completed our corporate rebranding to AvenuesAI Limited. This is not a cosmetic change. It's a structural evolution. We are no longer a payment gateway company. We are building an AI-native transaction infrastructure platform, which is full stack regulated, data-rich and compounding.

items.statement: Volume growth guidance for FY26 is around double-digit; medium- to long-term guidance maintained at 8-9% annualized
items.quote: If you see year-on-year, the growth is around 9% -- 9 months year-on-year. But we are expecting that Q4 will be slightly better, so we may touch around double-digit number. And guidance for the future year is, yes, around double-digit number we are planning.

items.statement: EBITDA per SCM margin guidance for FY26 around INR9; for next year INR8 to INR9
items.quote: And regarding the guidance for margins, I think we discussed earlier around INR10.20 for this year we have got EBITDA per SCM. And going forward, maybe INR8 to INR9 margins would be -- the numbers which we can look at.

items.statement: Capex guidance for FY27 around INR1,200 crore, mainly for GA-2, GA-3 and Unison areas
items.quote: be in the range of around INR1,200 crores. Aditya Welekar: And that will be towards which geographical area? Ashu Shinghal: Mainly GA-2, GA-3, larger amount. Maybe slightly lesser amount only on CNG in GA-1. And all 3 Unison acquired areas, roughly INR200 crores

items.statement: Added 120.3 km pipeline in Q3, total network over 8,182 km; added 6 CNG stations, total 491 as of Dec 2025
items.quote: We have laid 120.3 kilometers of steel and PE pipeline, taking the total length to over 8,182 kilometers. We have added 6 CNG stations during this quarter. And with this, we have 491 stations as on 31 December '25.

items.statement: Q3 overall volume 4.62 MMSCMD, up 0.59% QoQ and 7.19% YoY; CNG 3.281, DPNG 0.604, I&C 0.735 MMSCMD
items.quote: Coming to MGL's operations during the quarter, we achieved overall average sales volume of 4.62 MMSCMD as against 4.593 in the previous quarter, which is an increase of 0.59%. Current quarter volume consists of CNG volume of 3.281, DPNG volume of 0.604, and 0.735 MMSCMD of gas was supplied to industrial and commercial segment.

items.statement: 9M FY26 average volume 4.556 MMSCMD, up 8.97% YoY; CNG up 7.24%, I&C up 18.76%, DPNG up 7.53%
items.quote: Average gas sales for 9 months ending 31 December, '25 is 4.556, whereas it was 4.181 MMSCMD in the corresponding previous period of the last year, which is an increase of 8.97%.

items.statement: Reduced Henry Hub offtake by ~4% in Q3, swapped with HPHT and spot; Henry Hub avg cost up $0.14 QoQ, Brent-linked contracts saved ~$0.20
items.quote: So we tried taking as less as possible Henry Hub and replaced it either HPHT or spot. However, if you look at the average Henry Hub Index and the actual cost of Henry Hub, compared to previous quarter has hardly gone up by around $0.14. As against that, if you see APM, since Brent was lower, has seen a savings of almost $0.20.

items.statement: Signed new Brent-linked contracts: ~12,500 MMBtu/day from Jan (1-year), additional ~10,000 MMBtu/day from April (2-3 years) to reduce Henry Hub exposure
items.quote: Just to add, to take care of current HH volatility, we have already signed and started drawing from January some amount of Brent-linked contracts, new contracts, almost 12,500 MMBtu. And we have already in pipeline another additional maybe 10,000 MMBtu contract from April onwards.

items.statement: Q3 EBITDA INR352 crore vs INR338 crore QoQ; PAT INR202 crore vs INR193 crore; 9M EBITDA INR1,191 crore, PAT INR715 crore
items.quote: EBITDA from operations for the quarter is INR352 crores as compared to previous quarter EBITDA of INR338 crores. Net profit after tax for the quarter is INR202 crores as compared to previous quarter net profit after tax of INR193 crores. EBITDA for the 9 months ending December '25 is INR1,191 crores and net PAT is INR715 crores.

items.statement: Board approved interim dividend at 120% (INR12 per equity share) for FY26
items.quote: I'm also happy to announce that Board has approved an interim dividend for the current financial year at the rate of 120%, which is INR12 per equity share.

items.statement: Bombay High Court committee draft recommendations under discussion in ministry; likely phased implementation for BS4 and below vehicles, no knee-jerk reactions
items.quote: Regarding that Bombay High Court committee, we have prepared a draft recommendation, and these are under discussion in the ministry. So they will submit after that consent, we will -- I mean, I'm not exactly aware that when the final report will be submitted to the High Court. But there are not going to be very major knee-jerk reactions.

items.statement: Targeting large fleet owners for CNG conversion; signed one large transporter in JNPT area for ~300 trucks; offering upfront discounts via fuel cards
items.quote: We have had some traction with one large transporter in the JNPT area, with whom we are signing for converting about 300 of its trucks on to CNG. So we keep continuously looking at these kind of opportunities and offer them a good upfront discount also through a fuel card or something for getting their economics right.

items.statement: CNG revenue split: private cars/taxis ~35-40%, 3-wheelers ~35-40%, STUs ~7-8%, commercial goods vehicles/private buses remainder
items.quote: Private cars and taxis will be about 35%, 40%; almost a similar number for 3-wheelers; 7%-8% STUs and the remaining will be for commercial good vehicles, private buses etc.

items.statement: Net-zero Scope 1 and 2 target by 2036; importing green energy for electric compressors in Mumbai region
items.quote: We are also going for more carbon neutrality, and maybe by 2036, we will have net-zero Scope 1 and 2. We are importing green energy also for greenification of our electric-driven compressors in Mumbai region and nearby areas.

items.statement: Completed first international acquisition of CPD Singapore in January 2026 for international curriculum capabilities
items.quote: I am happy to share that we have completed our 1st International acquisition in January 2026 when we acquired CPD Singapore which gives us International Curriculum capabilities for the India and Asia markets.

items.statement: Targeting operating revenue above Rs8,000 million for FY26
items.quote: Firstly, we are looking to grow Operating revenues in excess of Rs8,000 million for the year.

items.statement: Targeting EBITDA margin band of 18%-20% for FY26
items.quote: Secondly, we are targeting EBITDA margin band of 18%-20% for this year.

items.statement: AI Dataset content licensing revenue reached Rs171 million in 9MFY26, targeting over Rs300 million for FY26
items.quote: We are absolutely confident of achieving revenues of more than Rs300m during FY26 (vs. Rs195m in FY25) in this segment.

items.statement: Q3 inventory days improved to 316 days from 366 days in 3QFY25, lowest in company history
items.quote: Our Q3 Inventory days was at 316 days (vs. 366 days in 3QFY25). This is the lowest Q3 Inventory days in the company's history.

items.statement: Q3 net working capital days improved to 143 days from 152 days in 3QFY25
items.quote: Our Q3 Net Working capital days was at 143 days (vs. 152 days in 3QFY25.

items.statement: Expect net cash of Rs120-125 crores by end of FY26 and Rs150+ crores by end of June 2026
items.quote: at the end of this year we will probably be around INR120 crores - INR125 crores and INR150 crores plus by the end of June.

items.statement: Open to buyback consideration in May board meeting based on cash flows and liquidity
items.quote: We'll look at what we end up with by the end of this year. We look at the cash flows around May when we announce our final results. That is the time we can take a call based upon the liquidity and the discussions that will happen internally at the Board level.

items.statement: NCF adoption expected to drive growth in CBSE/ICSE market over FY26-FY27 with full implementation in 2 years
items.quote: On the NCF front, we expect FY26 and FY27 to see maximum adoption of the new syllabus books which should help our growth trajectory in the CBSE/ICSE market.

items.statement: Margin expansion driven by product mix, higher content licensing revenues, and better realizations from new curriculum books
items.quote: Yes, it's a combination of product mix that we are having plus the higher content licensing revenues that we have plus with the new curriculum books, of course, the realizations are a bit better.

items.statement: Normalized growth for traditional publishing business expected at 8-10% post NCF transition
items.quote: So, percentage terms, it will be like, I would say, 8% to 10% would be a normalized growth for the company.

items.statement: Capex incurred during the year alongside acquisition
items.quote: We've done some capex this year, of course, and we've done an acquisition also.

items.statement: CPD Singapore acquisition adds international curriculum capacity for 1000+ schools in India and 10,000+ globally
items.quote: We plan to expand it in the next 2 to 3 years. So, we believe that the international school market is growing at a much faster pace in India and neighbouring countries.

items.statement: Gross margins moderated in 9MFY26 due to pricing rationalization in AI dataset licensing, offset by exponential volume growth
items.quote: During 9MFY26, on a consolidated level, we saw a moderation in our reported Gross margins % vs. 9MFY25. This was largely driven by a pricing in the content licensing (AI Datasets) revenues.

items.statement: Multiple partnerships including Allied, Discovery, Amar Chitra Katha, Money Prep, Liqvid, Speedlabs enhancing sales momentum
items.quote: Our multiple partnerships for content and Licensing including Allied (ICSE Books), Discovery, Amar Chitra Katha, Mo ney Prep (Financial Literacy), Liqvid (Language Labs), Speedlabs (JEE and NEET Foundation) and many more should hold us in good

items.statement: International curriculum market has global competitors like Pearson, Cambridge, Oxford but no domestic players with comparable portfolio
items.quote: You have competition from all the global players, Pearson, Cambridge itself and all the various publishers that have been licensed. Himanshu Gupta: Yes, like Oxford and the big players are there, but they are not local players

items.statement: NCERT direction to schools is recommendatory not mandatory; private schools prefer comprehensive private books over NCERT
items.quote: But as per the circular also, it is recommended to use the books. It's not that you have to compulsorily use the books. So private schools always have a choice to which books that they want to use.

items.statement: Syllabus change delayed from expected 2-3 years to 5-6 years, spreading growth impact over longer period
items.quote: So basically, the syllabus changes, as we expected, got delayed by the government. We expected the syllabus change to happen in over a 2-3-year period, but that is taking 4-5 years.

items.statement: Order inflow guidance of INR3,500 crores for FY26 already exceeded with INR3,909 crores booked year-to-date; expects further INR500-1,000 crores in next 45 days
items.value: INR3,500 crores guidance; INR3,909 crores achieved YTD; INR500-1,000 crores incremental expected
items.quote: Our order inflow targets worth INR3,500 crores. It stands at INR3,909 crores. That does not include the increase of contract values of CIDCO and MHADA due to price variation escalation. Capacit’e And therefore, the curr ent year target, if we achieve another INR1,000 crores will be close to INR5,000 crores, which will be about 35% over the target which we had given you all in April

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance of 18-20% for FY27 on expanded order book; expects to maintain similar growth for next 2-3 years
items.quote: Next financial year on an expanded order book basis, we definitely need to grow at 18% to 20% as per the commitments to our client. Over the past 2 years, we have been doing that quite well. And we hope to do that over the next 2, 3 years as well.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance of 16.5-17.5% for consolidated FY26 and FY27; standalone margin guidance 17.5-18.5%

items.statement: Net asset turnover of core assets 5.5x annualized for 9M FY26 vs 5.2x FY25; focus on increasing execution to improve utilization
items.quote: Net assets turnover of core assets stood at 5.5x on an annualized basis for the first 9 months FY '26 versus 5.2x for FY '25.

So I t hink we should see some traction on that in a couple of months

items.statement: Cuddalore Paste PVC facility operating at 100% utilization; R32 swing plant (2 KTPA) commissioning by end Q4 FY26, second 2 KTPA plant by Q1 FY27, 10 KTPA plant by end CY2026
items.quote: The Cuddalore Paste PVC facility is operating at full capacity utilization, reflecting steady operations and market absorption.

items.statement: Suspension PVC imports Apr-Dec 2025: 2.1M tons with China 52%, Japan 14%, Taiwan 9%, Korea 6%; Paste PVC imports: 62K tons with EU 45%, Korea 22%, Malaysia 8%, Taiwan/Thailand 7% each
items.quote: Out of the total import arrivals of around 2 million, 2.1 million tons in April to December -- the 9-month period April to December '25, China accounted for around 52% of the arrivals, Japan accounted for 14%, Taiwan accounted for 9% and Korea accounted for 6%.

items.statement: No equity fundraising plans currently; debt fundraising ongoing for projects and short-term needs as per plan
items.quote: As for equity raising is concerned, w e don't have any plans as of now. I can't comment about the next 2 years. But we don't have any plans as of

items.statement: Q3 FY26 most challenging in 3 years: net loss INR119 cr on revenue INR835 cr (21% YoY drop); 9M FY26 EBITDA INR4 cr, net loss INR234 cr
items.value: INR119 crores loss, INR835 crores revenue
items.quote: During the quarter, the company reported consolidated revenues of INR835 crores and a net loss of INR119 crores. This has been the most challengin g quarter in the last 3 years with multiple factors impacting our performance

items.statement: Revenue mix Q3 FY26: Specialty Chemicals 40%, Suspension PVC 47%, Value-added Chemicals 13%; Specialty Chemicals volume up 13% YoY
items.quote: Looking at the split of revenues for the quarter. Specialty Chemicals contributed 40% of revenues, value-added Chemicals accounted for 13%, while the Suspension PVC segment comprised the remaining 47%.

items.statement: European PVC industry under stress: Netherlands plant (230K tons) shut down, other plants in receivership; Chinese carbide PVC capacity rationalization expected post export rebate withdrawal
items.quote: Actually, we did se e some rationalization that has happened in Europe. There was one Netherlands plant at around 230,000 tons that shut down towards the end of last year. And then a few other plants of the same company in different parts of Europe have gone into receivership

items.statement: No large capex beyond announced R32 and residual CMCD expansions; rest is maintenance capex only
items.quote: Apart from maintenance capex, the announced capex i s the R32 that we have announced and whatever residual out of the CMCD expansions that w e have announced. And the rest is only maintenance capex. So if you want details on the ma intenance capex, and those details, we can always take off-line. So broadly, we don't see any large capex at least as of

items.statement: R32 first full year production target ~11,000 tons with annual revenue ~INR600 crores; not included in CMCD INR1,000 cr target
items.quote: the first full year, I think we target to make around 11,000 tons, and we should have around an annual revenue of INR550 crores

items.statement: Suspension PVC domestic consumption Apr-Dec 2025: 3.2M tons vs 3.3M tons YoY; expected to recover to flat or slightly positive for full year with strong demand return from January
items.quote: If you look at April to December '25, the consumption in India is around 3.2 million tons as compared to 3.3 million tons in the same period last year. And this is largely because of this year, there's been a far more extended monsoon and a pretty strong monsoon at that and also a lot of uncertainty on price volatility and the regulatory uncertainty.

items.statement: EU-India FTA details not yet released; parliamentary approvals needed; potential positive demand for Paste PVC via auto leather exports, CMCD benefits likely
items.quote: But if assuming that the automobile imports into I ndia increased from Europe and a lot of the artificial leather that is made from Paste PVC is P VC-based and a lot of our customers are exporting the leather to European car manufacturers, that could result in some positive demand pool in the market

items.statement: Management commits to not less than 35% revenue growth for at least the next three to four years.
items.quote: So my growth will be not less than 35%. You said double-digit, so I am in double-digit, very well in double-digit.

items.statement: Management targets PAT margin between 20% and 22% going forward.
items.quote: On the COGS side, you can expect COGS to the level of 53% to 55% and PAT margin somewhere between 20% to 22%.

items.statement: As of date, the company has 121 points of sale across India, with 16 opened this year and more in pipeline.
items.quote: As on date, we have total 121 point of sales across India and similar to this year, next year will be again about opening new stores.

items.statement: Revenue mix for nine months FY26 is 57% silver jewellery and 38% diamond jewellery; expected to shift to 55% silver and 45% diamond by H1 next year.
items.quote: Up to nine months, first nine months. And 57% is a silver jewellery. And I am expecting it to become almost 45% of the diamond and 55% of silver by H1 of next year.

items.statement: Indian fashion jewellery market is INR 10,000 crore today, likely to triple to INR 30,000 crore by 2030; organized share is under 10%.
items.quote: Indian fashion jewellery market is INR10,000 crores today, likely to be INR30,000 crores by 2030. Organized retail portion is less than 10% currently.

items.statement: Company is zero debt with cash balance of ~INR 70 crore in treasury and short-term deposits, sufficient for 25+ EBOs without debt or equity.
items.quote: It's a zero debt, cash balance is almost equivalent to the INR70 crores which is in the form of treasury, in form of short-term capital deposits with the bank and that is sufficient as Aditya has said to expand minimum 25 location in the coming year without asking for any debt from the market or without asking for the expansion to the equity.

items.statement: No dilution or debt required for expansion for at least next 18-24 months; promoter infused INR 10 crore equity at INR 970/share for pan-India marketing.
items.quote: No, as I said in coming at least 18 months' period, I am not requiring any dilution or any debt for funding the expansion either FOCO model, FOFO model, company-owned or third-party franchise.

items.statement: BIS notification coming shortly will prohibit using 'diamond' word for lab-grown diamonds; they must mention LGD or stone.
items.quote: Natural diamond is a precisely thing, we need to keep in mind because very shortly whoever is selling the lab-grown diamond will not be allowed to use diamond word in their billing or in their sales matter. They need to mention either LGD or stone, not even precious stone. So that BIS standards and BIS notification is coming very shortly.

items.statement: Same-store growth (SSG) at PNG (SIS) locations is not less than 25%; EBOs are too new for normalized SSG.
items.quote: At PNG side it is not less than 25%. And on EBO side, since these are new EBOs all our EBOs are new. So last year it did 40 lakhs this year 1.5 crores, so I will not say it is a two and half times because it is not going to get repeat.

items.statement: No explicit dividend or buyback mentioned; focus on retaining earnings for expansion and maintaining zero debt.
items.quote: I am too conservative, that's why I can keep that treasury. Whatever earning is there I am retaining it very properly and very carefully.

items.statement: Main board listing targeted by September 2026 after FY26 results; criteria of 3 years >INR 15 cr operating profit will be met with FY24, FY25, FY26.
items.quote: So we can get listed in main board after the declaration of result for 31st March and it is on the track, we are preparing for that and you will get it to see if everything goes correct through the regulators and everything by September '26, you will see ourselves on the main board.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA expected largely in line with last year with only marginal growth
items.quote: Looking ahead for the full year FY '26, we expect EBITDA to be largely in line with last year with only marginal growth.

items.statement: Confident of meeting CDMO revenue guidance for FY26 but exceeding target now looks difficult due to project delivery delays
items.quote: We are confident of meeting our CDMO revenue guidance for FY '26. However, exceeding that target, which was earlier a possibility, now looks difficult due to certain project deliveries getting pushed by a few months.

items.statement: Atali plant capex: INR300 crores capitalized so far, total project outlay INR450 crores, balance to be completed in next couple of months
items.quote: No. So we have done the capitalization of around INR300 crores and the total project outlay is around INR450 crores. So that balance, certain second phase is getting completed. And we will have that completion happening in next couple of months.

items.statement: Xanthine expansion project approved at INR150 crores across both sites
items.quote: Xanthine in total, the project that we have approved is around INR150 crores, with both the sites together.

items.statement: At least one new block coming up at Atali in FY27, not a large capex
items.quote: Yes, yes, we will have at least one block coming up in Atali in next year. So we will get that capex approval going forward.

items.statement: Atali plant started qualifying batches in Q3 FY26, encountered startup hiccups, expect resolution by end of Q4 FY26
items.quote: Atali plant started production of qualifying batches in Q3 FY '26. While ramping up Phase 1, we have encountered some starting hiceups, which impacted the production plan. We have taken corrective actions in place, and we expect the resolution by end of the current quarter

items.statement: Xanthine expansion targeting mechanical completion by end of March 2026, incremental capacity available for production in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The Xanthine expansion is progressing as planned, and we are targeting the mechanical completion by end of March '26. The incremental capacity will become available for the production in Q1 FY '27.

items.statement: Current Xanthine capacity 500 tonnes/month, adding 300 tonnes/month to reach 800 tonnes/month (9,600 tonnes/year) after expansion
items.quote: Yes. See, currently, as I have informed all of you in the last call that we are currently running at around 500 tonnes per month capacity and slowly ramping it up. With the new capacities coming up, we are adding close to 300 tonnes per month additional capacity. So, we will have that available.

items.statement: Xanthine capacity utilization expected at 50-60% average in FY27, targeting 85-90% by FY28
items.quote: Overall will be 50%, 60%.

items.statement: CDMO: 21 customers, 59 active projects (40 commercial, 19 development), commercial projects increased from 33 to 40 in last 9 months
items.quote: We are working with 21 customers and the number of active projects are 59, out of which 40 projects are in the commercial stage and 19 are under various stages of development, both at customer end.

items.statement: CDMO revenue target INR1,000 crores, FY27 growth expected similar to FY26
items.quote: That is the target that we have, yes.

items.statement: API business seeing margin pressure but early recovery indications emerging, focusing on patent expiry opportunities over coming years
items.quote: The API business continues to see some margin pressure. While early indication of recovery are emerging, we remain vigilant and are directing all our efforts towards patent expiry over coming years.

items.statement: Xanthine pricing bottomed out, China rebate withdrawal and US duty advantage expected to push prices up 8-10%
items.quote: We are seeing some increase in the pricing overall. I think, in the spot market, we have seen around 5% increase in the price from lower level. So we are seeing that the overall pricing has bottomed out.

items.statement: API: validating oncology APIs, improving diabetic processes, few launches in 2026 including Apixaban and anticancer products, patent expiries around 2027-28
items.quote: Yes, we are validating quite a few APLs on oncology side, and also improving our manufacturing processes on diabetic side. However, some of these APIs will have the patent expiry somewhere around 27, 28.

items.statement: CDMO customer count stable at 21, expecting addition in calendar year 2026, good new inquiries from BD team
items.quote: Yes, yes. We expect this customer number to go up in calendar year '26.

items.statement: INR49 crores goods in transit as of Dec 31 2025 (COGS INR30 crores), normally INR10-12 crores, will be recognized in Q4 adding INR19 crores PBT
items.quote: Apart from Q3 reported sales, another INR49 crores worth of goods were in transit as of 31st December '25. These goods could not be booked as sales due to accounting norms.

items.statement: Q3 FY26 EBITDA INR103 crores vs INR115 crores YoY, FY26 EBITDA expected flat YoY due to Atali delays and API softness
items.quote: The EBITDA was INR103 crores as compared to INR115 crores for the corresponding period of the previous year.

items.statement: API pricing always goes down in generic business, growth to come from capacity increases and new product launches
items.quote: See, generic APT business, the prices never increase. They always go down only. Ultimately, the game has to be played where you increase the capacity.

items.statement: API quarterly run rate target INR200 crores, then higher; FY25 API revenue ~INR770 crores, FY26 tracking ~INR650-670 crores
items.quote: I think the first milestone s, as you rightly mentioned, quarterly INR200 crores. And then the next milestone will be higher than that, quarterly

items.statement: New CSO joined, working aggressively on oncology pipeline strategy
items.quote: Also, we have the new CSO who has joined. We are working very aggressive on revisiting our strategy and working to capture the oncology pipeline carly on

items.statement: CDMO growth contingent on innovator partners' launch success and market penetration, first year post-launch often sees dip
items.quote: Of course, we have to keep our finger crossed. We — our partners have to make sure that their launch drugs are being successful and they don't have any hiceups. So everything is contingent to how they are performing, post launch

items.statement: China withdrawing 13% export rebate on caffeine and salts, US duty 20% on Chinese caffeine vs India duty-free, favorable for exports
items.quote: China has announced that they will withdraw the benefit - rebate benefit on caffeine and its salts. With that rebate withdrawal, overall 13% benefit that is getting accrued to the Chinese manufacturers when they export the APL that will go away

items.statement: Q4 FY26 residential launches of INR4,000-5,000 crores GDV in Noida (Max One Sector 16B and Sector 105)
items.quote: Driven by this encouraging response to Estate 361, Max Estates is now planning launches, aggregating about INR4,000 crores GDV in Noida, comprising of Max One in Sector 16B and a project in Sector 105 in Noida targeted for Q4 FY '26.

items.statement: FY27 collection target of INR2,800-3,000 crores from existing and new sales
items.quote: It will more range close to in the range of INR2,800 crores to INR3,000 crores.

items.statement: Commercial portfolio annuity rental income potential of over INR700 crores annually on 100% basis across delivered and under-construction assets
items.quote: Overall, commercial portfolio is poised for an annuity rental income potential of more than INR700 crores annually on a 100% basis across delivered and under-construction assets over the next few years.

items.statement: Pre-leased 200,000 sq ft at Max District Gurugram at gross rentals over INR270 crores over 9-year lease at 35% premium to micro market
items.quote: highlighted by the signing of an LOI for a long-term lease, pre-leasing 200,000 square feet at Max District, Sector 65, in Gurugram, securing gross rentals of over INR270 crores over the lease period. The transaction has been concluded 2.5 years ahead of the project completion and at a 35% premium to the prevailing micro market rentals.

items.statement: Q3 FY26 project spend ~INR350 crores plus INR450 crores for Golf Course Extension land acquisition
items.quote: what we have incurred in the current quarter is a number in and around INR350 crores on the project. In addition, in the current quarter, we also paid out for the new acquisition, which we did on the Golf Course Extension Road, which had an outlay of close to INR450 crores.

items.statement: FY27 business development capital deployment of ~INR1,000 crores for 1-2M sq ft residential and 1-1.5M sq ft commercial
items.quote: In terms of GDV, what we expect is to deploy a capital of close to INR1,000 crores across the residential and commercial.

items.statement: Adjusted operating margin in excess of 25% for Q3 FY26 after adding back marketing expenses
items.quote: If we adjust for that, we would be looking at an operating margin in excess of 25%.

items.statement: Estate 128 (outright) margins 40-45%; Estate 360/361 (JDA) margins 22-25% with similar IRRs
items.quote: in the case of Estate 28, we would be having margins in the range of 40% to 45%, which is an outright asset. And in the case of Estate 360 and 361, which are in the nature of joint development agreement, we will have margins of 22%, 25%.

items.statement: Net debt INR414 crores as of Dec'25 (gross debt INR1,700 crores including INR1,000 crores LRD, cash INR1,284 crores); no incremental debt taken
items.quote: The debt as on December '25 stood at INR1,700 crores, including LRDs of INR1,000 crores. and cash equivalents as of December '25 stood at INR1,284 crores, resulting in the company having a net debt of INR414 crores.

items.statement: Commercial debt: INR1,000 crores lease rental discounting + INR600 crores construction finance; residential debt: zero; residential cash INR1,200 crores locked in RERA accounts
items.quote: we will have a major rental discounting, which is completely on the commercial asset, which is close to INR1,000 crores and the construction finance debt of close to INR600 crores, which is on the commercial side. On the residential assets, we are not carrying any debt.

items.statement: 9M FY26 collections ~INR1,100 crores vs construction spend ~INR450 crores
items.quote: in the 9 months FY '26, what we would have collected would be a number of close to INR1,100 crores as we speak, and we would have incurred a cost of close to INR450 crores on the projects undergoing projects.

items.statement: Max Square Two (1M sq ft) OC expected Q2 FY28; Max District (1.6M sq ft) OC in two phases: Q2 FY28 and Q3 FY29
items.quote: Max Square Two project in Noida, having a leasable area of 1 million square feet is on track and expected to receive occupation certificate by Quarter 2 of FY '28. Max District, Sector 65, Gurugram, having a leasable area of 1.6 million square feet is also on track for completion and expected to receive occupancy certificate in 2 phases. Quarter 2 of FY '28 and Quarter 3 of FY '29.

items.statement: Operational commercial assets at 100% occupancy (1.23M sq ft) generating INR155+ crores annual rental income
items.quote: Our operational commercial real estate assets, Max Towers in Noida, Max House Phase 1 and Phase 2 at Okhla, and Max Square, again at Noida continue to operate at 100% occupancy, generating an annual rental income of over INR155 crores.

items.statement: Estate 361 average realization INR22,000/sq ft, significant premium to micro market and Estate 360
items.quote: More so, average price realization in this development currently stands at INR22,000 a square foot, reflecting a significant premium to the prevailing micro market as well as to our previous launch project Estate 360.

items.statement: Strong GCC sector interest for commercial leasing; healthy pipeline for Max Square Two and Max District
items.quote: So this comes from the GCC sector itself, this transaction and we are getting very good traction and have a very healthy pipeline for both our projects in Noida at Max Square Two, and Gurugram.

items.statement: Focus on premium residential (INR6-14 crores ticket) and senior living across Noida and Gurugram
items.quote: We are mostly in the premium segment. We continue to operate in that, and we are very focused in that segment. Like I said, we are both in the premium segment and also in the senior living segment. And they straddle the range of the entire premium category upwards of INR6 crores, INR7 crores up till about INR12 crores, INR13 crores, INR14 crores.

items.statement: Max One Sector 16B Noida: 2.5M sq ft mixed-use (ultra-luxury residential, Grade-A office, retail, club) with GDV >INR2,000 crores and INR120 crores annuity potential
items.quote: Spread across a total parcel with a development potential of 2.5 million square feet, the project is targeted to launch in the current quarter and carries a GDV potential of over INR2,000 crores, along with an estimated annuity annual potential of INR120 crores.

items.statement: Sector 105 Noida: 10.33 acres, 2.6M sq ft mixed residential/commercial, Phase 1 GDV >INR3,000 crores
items.quote: Additionally, the company has also acquired a 10.33-acre prime land parcel in Sector 105, Noida, strategically located on the Noida-Greater Noida Expressway. The project will comprise a mix of residential and commercial development with a total developable area of 2.6 million square feet, Phase 1 alone offers a GDV potential of over INR3,000 crores.

items.statement: Delhi land pooling policy: no incremental progress; hopeful to move approval process forward in coming year
items.quote: So far, there is no incremental progress based on what we had last reported, but we continue to work for the approvals and are very hopeful that in the coming year or so we should be able to move the needle on the approval process.

items.statement: Initiated solar power sourcing for Max Square; target 50% portfolio energy from renewables by 2030
items.quote: The company has also initiated solar power sourcing for our Max Square project, representing a key milestone in our sustainability and de-carbonization road map. This marks the first move towards Max Estates' long-term goal of shifting 50% of our portfolio's energy usage to renewable sources by 2030.

items.statement: Hired Vachan Singh as COO Projects (35 years experience across DLF, Tata, L&T Realty, Oberoi Realty); 300-person execution team
items.quote: we made some organizational changes, and we hired Mr. Vachan Singh, who joined us as Chief Operating Officer Projects. He now -- he spent about 35 years in the industry across organizations like DLF, Tata, L&T Realty, Oberoi Realty and many others. We have a team of almost 300 people that are under him.

items.statement: Lease rental income up 38% YoY to INR115 crores in 9M FY26; Max Asset Services revenue INR40 crores in 9M
items.quote: The lease rental income is up 38% year-on-year to INR115 crores in 9 months. Max Asset Services, the facility management arm continues to clock revenue of INR40 crores in 9 months.

items.statement: No FY27 presales guidance given; focused on achieving Q4 FY26 targets first
items.quote: At this stage, we would not like to give guidance for FY '27. I think we are focused in the next 1.5 months of achieving what we had said.

items.statement: Hopeful to become dividend-paying company within 2.5 years after residential project completions and OC receipts starting with Estate 128
items.quote: We are very hopeful that with the completion of our residential projects in the next 2.5 years, we should get to that point because, as you know, the accounting in the real estate company, the profit will only be recorded on the books once we are able to get the OC.

items.statement: Revenue run rate currently INR 220-250 crore per quarter; expected to rise to INR 270-280 crore per quarter after full ASK rollout by Q3/Q4 FY27
items.quote: We are right now running at about INR 230 to INR 250 crores for the last 2 to 3 quarters. This run rate is going to continue. With the ASK revenue comes into play after a couple of quarters on a full-scale basis, we will have addition of another INR 40 to 50 crores into run rate for sure.

items.statement: Existing businesses to grow 8-10% annually; new businesses targeted to reach 25% of revenue in 2-3 years from 11-12% currently
items.quote: Our existing businesses, which is Tax, CRA and foundational identity businesses continues to grow at an average rate of 8% to 10%. Our new businesses in the next 2 to 3 years will contribute about 25% to revenues.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expansion of 300-400 basis points over longer term from current 19%
items.quote: So, EBITDA, we are already at 19%, if you see. So, there will be an expansion of 300 to 400 basis points, which is what we said last time also in next couple of years once we start growing our revenues at this stage.

items.statement: Unexecuted order book stands at over INR 1,600 crore, nearly twice annual revenue, anchored in digital identity and open digital ecosystems
items.quote: The unexecuted order book stands at over INR 1,600 crores, nearly twice our annual revenue. These opportunities are largely anchored in digital identity and open digital ecosystems.

items.statement: Q3 FY26 EBITDA grew 34% YoY to INR 46 crore with margin expanding 335 bps to 19%; 9M FY26 EBITDA margin 18%, up 103 bps YoY
items.quote: EBITDA grew by 34% YoY to INR 46 crores with margins expanding by 335 basis points to 19%.

items.statement: Tax services issued over 1.1 crore PAN cards, consolidated market share at 59% supported by Aadhaar-PAN linkage deadline extension
items.quote: We issued over 1.1 crore PAN cards and consolidated our market share at 59%.

items.statement: CRA business onboarded over 35 lakh new subscribers, captured 94% incremental market share, holds 98% cumulative share across NPS, APY, UPS
items.quote: We onboarded over 35 lakh new subscribers during this quarter and captured 94% of the incremental market share. We continue to hold a dominant 98% cumulative market share across NPS, APY and UPS.

items.statement: PFRDA restructured CRA pricing to AUM-linked model for private/non-government sector; temporary revenue impact but long-term growth expected as AUM grows
items.quote: The regulator has guided a shift towards an AUM-linked charge structure with the objective of increasing overall assets under management.

items.statement: New businesses contributed 11% of operating revenue in 9M FY26 vs 4% in FY25, expanding across insurance, health, agriculture, education, identity
items.quote: In the first nine months of FY26, they contributed in double digits, 11% of operating revenue compared to 4% in FY25.

items.statement: Completed first phase of UIDAI mandate with 34 Aadhaar Seva Kendras operational across 19 states/UTs; revenue generation commenced, early performance in line with expectations
items.quote: We have successfully completed the first phase of the UIDAI mandate and operationalized 34 Aadhaar Seva Kendras across 19 States and Union Territories. Revenue generation has commenced and early performance is in line with expectations.

items.statement: Full ASK rollout of 190 centres targeted by September 2025; expected to add INR 40-50 crore per quarter to revenue run rate from Q3/Q4 FY27
items.quote: As per the mandate, Protean has to roll out 190 centres, out of which 34 are already rolled out in this quarter. By September, we should be able to roll out everything, from a Q3 or Q4 of next year, you should see the run rate going up significantly.

items.statement: Won INR 25 crore strategic mandate to implement digital public infrastructure for Ethiopian agricultural ecosystem; 4 international mandates across 3 markets now secured
items.quote: We won a strategic national level mandate valued at INR 25 crores to implement the digital public infrastructure for the Ethiopian agricultural ecosystem.

items.statement: Cash reserves of INR 800 crore to fund working capital for large RFP projects like CERSAI and Bima Sugam; no debt on balance sheet
items.quote: This cash will be used, one in funding the working capital for all these large RFP projects, which we are winning like CERSAI or Bima Sugam, a couple of projects which will come in future.

items.statement: Company remains debt-free with INR 800 crore in cash and marketable securities as of 31 December 2025
items.quote: As of 31st December 2025, we had ~INR 800 crores of cash and cash equivalents and we continue to remain debt-free.

items.statement: Senior management exits due to retirements (3) and planned restructuring for project delivery vertical; restructuring complete, strong leadership in place
items.quote: 3 people actually retired over the course of the year, there were a couple of others who moved out because of structured realignment, that was the case. So, it's not a bulk sort of movement in that sense, but triggered for different reasons.

items.statement: CRA subscriber additions ~35-40 lakh per quarter; pricing shift to AUM-linked model for private sector; normalized growth 12-14% excluding pricing impact
items.quote: Every quarter, we are adding approximately 35 to 40 lakh subscribers. So, subscribers have not fallen, but there was a price restructuring during the quarter by PFRDA just to get the ecosystem larger and bigger.

items.statement: MD Suresh Sethi announced personal decision to move on; board and management ensured robust succession planning and seamless transition
items.quote: For personal and professional reasons, I'm moving ahead. The intention was to create a very robust succession planning in place and that we have done. And we have moved forward with that.

items.statement: PFRDA introduced multi-scheme framework, withdrawal flexibility, and AUM-linked pricing to expand pension penetration in non-government sector
items.quote: Multiple regulatory reforms have been introduced, primarily focusing on significantly expanding pension penetration, parti cularly in the non - government sector

items.statement: Identity business revenues impacted by slab-based pricing and competitive pressures; focus on scaling volumes, market share, value-added offerings
items.quote: While revenues were impacted by slab-based pricing and competitive pressures, our focus remains on scaling volumes, expanding market share and growing value-added offerings.

items.statement: Cloud strategy evolving: evaluating sovereign cloud deployment for large projects and independent cloud sales; clarity expected in 1-2 quarters; open to hyperscaler partnerships
items.quote: We are internally discussing and strategising where we should deploy our cloud, whether it will be for our large project or whether we can independently also sell cloud. So right now, we are in a strategic phase for this business.

items.statement: Medium-term EBITDA margin target range of 29% to 31%
items.quote: Our focus remains on maintaining EBITDA margins within a sustained range between 29% to 31% over the medium term.

items.statement: Q3 FY26 EBITDA margin reached 30.8%, 9M FY26 at 30.1%
items.quote: EBITDA margin settled at 30.8% and 30.1%, respectively, as a result of operating leverage.

items.statement: Q3 FY26 volume growth of ~14% YoY driven by domestic CV, farm, industrial and PV segments
items.quote: We recorded a healthy year -on-year volume growth of approximately 14%, driven by a strong uptick across domestic CV, farm and industrial segments, as well as the passenger vehicle segment overall contributed meaningfully.

items.statement: Visibility of incremental peak annual business of ~INR800 crores from FY27, scaling over 2-3 years
items.quote: We have visibility of new and incremental peak annual business of approximately INR800 crores, expected to commence from FY '27 onwards, which will scale up over the next 2 to 3 years.

items.statement: FY26 capex guidance INR400-500 crores; FY27 capex ~INR400 crores excl solar, ~INR480 crores incl solar
items.quote: With INR300 crores deployed in the first 9 months of the year, we expected our total capex for FY '26 to be in the range of INR400 crores to INR500 crores

items.statement: Machining capacity increased to 68,000 MT in Q3 FY26; 10,000 ton press in Q4 FY26, 4,000 ton press in H1 FY27
items.quote: We increased our machining capacity to 68,000 MT, an addition of 9,800 MT in quarter 3 FY '26. This expansion is in anticipation of the upcoming demand. Further, we will strengthen our forging capacities by commissioning a new 10,000 ton press in quarter 4 FY '26 and the 4,000 ton press in H1 FY '27.

items.statement: Forex hedged for 1-1.5 years forward; mix of pass-through and long-term hedged contracts

items.statement: Gross margin improvement driven by product mix changes and new product introductions at better realizations

items.statement: Balance sheet strong; growth funded from internal accruals; no financial impact from new Labour Code

items.statement: Confident of maintaining gross margins going forward
